item.subject: science
item.stem: Meena's father in Pune has been diagnosed with type 2 diabetes. The doctor explains how the family should manage his condition. Which statement gives the correct approach to controlling this non-communicable disease?

options.A: One complete course of diabetes medicine will cure him permanently, so no further care is needed.
options.B: Reducing his physical activity will lower his risk of heart disease.
options.C: He needs continuous care, regular checkups, a balanced diet, and daily exercise to manage the disease.
options.D: Since he looks healthy, he does not need regular checkups or any change in lifestyle.
